ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle C=90^\circ$, $BC=1$, and $AC=\sqrt{3}$. Find the values of $\tan A$ and $\tan B$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given in right-angled triangle $ABC$, $\angle C=90^\circ$, $BC=1$, and $AC=\sqrt{3}$,\\
thus, $\tan A=\frac{BC}{AC}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{3}$,\\
$\tan B=\frac{AC}{BC}=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{1}=\boxed{\sqrt{3}}$.
